title: When anger rises quickly under pressure
issueStatement: The mind reacts before truth and proportion have time to speak. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru turns the battle inward so reaction loses its claim to righteousness. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it.
actionPrompt: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.

source.shortMeaning: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?
